name: Robo IVR Call Pakistan
author: H3 Technologies

sections.description:
Automated Order Confirmation:
Once an order is placed on your WordPress site, the plugin automatically initiates an IVR voice call to confirm the order details with the customer.

Customizable Voice Prompts:
Customize the voice prompts to match your brand’s tone and voice for better engagement.

Improved Customer Satisfaction:
Offer quick and hassle-free order confirmation, leading to increased customer satisfaction and loyalty.

One Click Setup:
Setup the robo call service easily by entering your email address and API key, which can be generated via our Developer Documentation.

Short Description

Verify orders with IVR voice calls for automated confirmation, enhancing security and customer satisfaction.

External Services

This plugin connects to external APIs for verifying API keys and managing voice calls. The following external services are used:

H3 Techs API

  • Service: Provides API key verification and call initiation.
  • Endpoints:
    • https://secure.h3techs.com/sms/api/mask – Verifies API key and email.
    • https://secure.h3techs.com/sms/api/send_voice – Initiates voice calls.
    • https://secure.h3techs.com/sms/api/get_call – Retrieves call data.
  • Data Sent:
    • API key, email, voice ID, caller ID, and call ID.
  • Terms & Privacy:
    • Privacy Policy
    • Terms of Use

Branded SMS Pakistan API

  • Service: Provides API verification and call management.
  • Endpoints:
    • https://rc-b2b.kiz.app/api/user_verify – Verifies API key.
    • https://rc-b2b.kiz.app/api/get_call/ – Retrieves call data.
    • https://rc-b2b.kiz.app/api/calls – Initiates calls with parameters.
  • Data Sent:
    • API key, voice ID, caller ID, and call ID.
  • Terms & Privacy:
    • Privacy Policy
    • Terms of Use

Data Handling

  • API key and email are sent during verification.
  • Call data (caller ID, voice ID, call ID) is sent during call initiation and retrieval.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Login to your WordPress Admin Panel.
  2. Search for “Robo IVR Call Pakistan” through the Plugins > Add New interface.
  3. Click on the Install Now button in the plugin box.
  4. Activate the plugin.
  5. You will see Robo IVR Call Pakistan on the left menu. Click on it, and on the configuration page, enter your email and API key (which you can generate in the SMS Portal).
  6. Done! If you have any questions, contact us at hello@brandedsmspakistan.com or WhatsApp at +923151231015.

Manual Installation

  1. Download Robo IVR Call Pakistan.
  2. Upload it through Plugins > Add New > Upload or upload the robo-ivr-call-pakistan folder to /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  3. Activate the plugin via the Plugins menu.
  4. Enter your email and API key (available via the SMS Portal). See the FAQ for more details.
sections.faq:
How do I register with Robo IVR Call Pakistan?

You can register for free at https://secure.h3techs.com/sms/account/signup.

Is any modification required to integrate SMS?

No, simply install, activate, and enter the API key from the SMS portal.

Where is my API Key?

Generate or regenerate your API Key by visiting https://secure.h3techs.com/sms/developers/key/.

Is this plugin free?

Yes, the plugin is completely free to use.

PHP Support

Yes! Robo IVR Call Pakistan supports PHP versions 7.x and 8.x.
